package cmd

import (
 "fmt"
 "encoding/json"
 "net/http/httptest"
 "strings"
 "testing"
 "time"
)

func TestGeneratedCRUD(t *testing.T) {
 db, err := OpenDatabase()
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 sqlDB, err := db.DB()
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 defer sqlDB.Close()
 tx := db.Begin()
 if tx.Error != nil { t.Fatal(tx.Error) }
 defer tx.Rollback()
 schema := fmt.Sprintf("modkit_test_%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
 if err := tx.Exec("CREATE SCHEMA " + schema).Error; err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 if err := tx.Exec("SET LOCAL search_path TO " + schema).Error; err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 router := NewRouter()
 for _, initialize := range moduleInitializers {
  if err := initialize(tx, router); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 }
 checks := []struct{ method, path, body string; status int; contains string }{
  {"GET", "/healthz", "", 200, "ok"},
  {"GET", "/sales/customer", "", 200, "[]"},
  {"POST", "/sales/customer", "{", 400, ""},
  {"POST", "/sales/customer", "{}", 400, ""},
  {"POST", "/sales/customer", `{"id":"c1","name":"Alice","active":true,"balance":12}`, 201, "Alice"},
  {"POST", "/sales/customer", `{"id":"c1"}`, 409, ""},
  {"GET", "/sales/customer/c1", "", 200, "Alice"},
  {"GET", "/sales/customer", "", 200, "Alice"},
  {"PUT", "/sales/customer/c1", `{"id":"wrong"}`, 400, ""},
  {"PUT", "/sales/customer/c1", `{"name":"","active":false,"balance":0}`, 200, `"balance":0`},
  {"GET", "/sales/customer/c1", "", 200, `"active":false`},
  {"PUT", "/sales/customer/missing", "{}", 404, ""},
  {"GET", "/sales/customer/missing", "", 404, ""},
  {"POST", "/sales", `{"id":"s1"}`, 201, "s1"},
  {"GET", "/sales/s1", "", 200, "s1"},
  {"DELETE", "/sales/customer/c1", "", 204, ""},
  {"GET", "/sales/customer/c1", "", 404, ""},
  {"DELETE", "/sales/customer/c1", "", 404, ""},
 }
 for _, check := range checks {
  request := httptest.NewRequest(check.method, check.path, strings.NewReader(check.body))
  request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
  response := httptest.NewRecorder()
  if err := tx.SavePoint("request").Error; err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
  router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
  if response.Code >= 400 { if err := tx.RollbackTo("request").Error; err != nil { t.Fatal(err) } }
  if response.Code != check.status || !strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), check.contains) {
   t.Fatalf("%s %s: got %d %s; want %d containing %q", check.method, check.path, response.Code, response.Body.String(), check.status, check.contains)
  }
 }

 // Exercise both the module's primary entity and an additional entity.
 for _, path := range []string{"/sales", "/sales/customer"} {
  for _, id := range []string{"p3", "p1", "p2"} {
   request := httptest.NewRequest("POST", path, strings.NewReader(fmt.Sprintf(`{"id":%q}`, id)))
   request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
   response := httptest.NewRecorder()
   router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
   if response.Code != 201 { t.Fatalf("seed: %d %s", response.Code, response.Body.String()) }
  }
  total := int64(3)
  if path == "/sales" { total = 4 } // Existing s1 from CRUD checks.
  for _, test := range []struct {
   query string
   offset, size int
   ids []string
  }{
   {"?offset=0&limit=2",0,2,[]string{"p1","p2"}},
   {"?offset=2&limit=2",2,2,func() []string { if total == 4 { return []string{"p3","s1"} }; return []string{"p3"} }()},
   {"?offset=1&limit=2",1,2,[]string{"p2","p3"}},
   {"?offset=99&limit=2",99,2,[]string{}},
   {"",0,20,func() []string { if total == 4 { return []string{"p1","p2","p3","s1"} }; return []string{"p1","p2","p3"} }()},
   {"?limit=100",0,100,func() []string { if total == 4 { return []string{"p1","p2","p3","s1"} }; return []string{"p1","p2","p3"} }()},
  } {
   response := httptest.NewRecorder()
   router.ServeHTTP(response, httptest.NewRequest("GET", path+test.query,nil))
   var result struct {
    Items []struct { ID string }
    Offset int
    Limit int `json:"limit"`
    Total int64
   }
   if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &result); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
   if response.Code != 200 || result.Offset != test.offset || result.Limit != test.size || result.Total != total || result.Items == nil || len(result.Items) != len(test.ids) {
    t.Fatalf("%s%s: unexpected pagination: %s",path,test.query,response.Body.String())
   }
   for i,id := range test.ids { if result.Items[i].ID != id { t.Fatalf("unexpected order: %s",response.Body.String()) } }
  }
  for _, query := range []string{
   "?offset=-1", "?offset=abc", "?offset=", "?limit=",
   "?limit=0", "?limit=-1", "?limit=101", "?limit=abc",
   "?offset=9999999999999999999999999", "?limit=9999999999999999999999999",
  } {
   response := httptest.NewRecorder()
   router.ServeHTTP(response,httptest.NewRequest("GET",path+query,nil))
   if response.Code != 400 { t.Fatalf("%s%s: expected 400, got %d",path,query,response.Code) }
  }
 }
}
